title: tridens flavus var. aristatus
intro: Tridens flavus var. aristatus, commonly known as Purple Needlegrass, is a perennial grass native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its antispasmodic and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Purple Needlegrass include its ability to relax the respiratory tract and alleviate symptoms of bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Tridens flavus var. aristatus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
